transcript.answer: I couldn't read the source file, so I can't say exactly which line defines it. The threshold is a cosine similarity of 0.92. A new fact at or above 0.92 similarity to an existing valid fact counts as contradicting it. The old fact is then invalidated (`valid_to` and `invalidated_by` are set) and a row is written to `memory.fact_conflicts`. The value is configurable through the `LORE_FACT_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD` env var, with a default of 0.92. The specs say the logic is in `invalidateContradictions()` in `libs/server-core/src/work/memory/facts.ts`, and I assume the default is read there. That is inferred from the specs, not confirmed in the code.
